title: Country house
content: It’s dark out and someone has chased me on a back country road. I Drove there but I jump out and run into a house that sits on the right side on the road. An old woman lets me in. I tell her not to tell the man chasing me that I’m there but she does. When I walk in it transforms into a costume place with mannequins and clowns I run to the back and swing open the changing room door and it leads to a lot of other doors and it becomes almost like a mirror maze of doors. Anyone else been to that house? You pass a big black house that is on the left before you get to this one.
